three_outcomes_not_two: A test that errors is not a test that failed. Counting an import error as 'fails on base' would let a broken test file certify a candidate, so DOES_NOT_RUN is separate from PASSES_ON_BASE and from FAILS_AS_EXPECTED. None of the 33 errored.
